task_specification.objective: Produce a new candidate on which the host-extended replay can conclusively pass: one receipt bound to the new hash with data-goldenpath-state=pass at 16/16 as host-observed evidence, product_ui_separation=pass, live captures of Today, Inbox, Projects, Calendar, Focus, and Settings, and readable deeplink counters — while preserving the anonymous smoke, embedded-assets build, clean session lifecycle, green 20/20 unit suite, and rustfmt-clean sources.

diagnosis.root_cause: All five active issues share one root cause: the registered replay never clicks #golden-path-trigger (no tools/ reference to it) and golden_path_observation() at tools/tauri_native_lifecycle.py:63-82 hardcodes observed.golden_path.state=unavailable, so the candidate's implemented, unit-proven 16-step drive (20/20 rust units, collector-readable probe, backend-held credentials, six views present under src/views) cannot produce a bound receipt. Loop-09 explicitly deferred this host repair, leaving section-3 runtime proof, signed-in surface exercise and capture, and deeplink counters evidence-stalled behind a measurement-infrastructure blocker rather than any known product defect.

stop_conditions: If the live self-drive cannot reach a terminal data-goldenpath-state in the embedded-assets build after honest fixes, stop and report the failing step and reason code instead of widening the trigger or auto-starting the drive.
If surface fixes would change the frozen probe contract, credentials handling, or the anonymous smoke, stop and report; the frozen contract outranks new polish.
If the host collector extension does not land this loop, report the receipt-based acceptance as blocked rather than substituting candidate self-reports as evidence.
Never add automatic test-account creation, mail-token consumption, or synthetic data mutations on normal startup to satisfy a collector or shortcut the drive.

strategy.rationale: Loops 8-9 repeated one strategy: build more candidate-side terminal contract while deferring the host collector repair, so every fingerprint recurred. Loop 10 inverts it: treat the host-owned trigger/poll/promote replay extension as the critical path, freeze the proven contract, and spend the single candidate task on closing the unit-versus-live gap and making the six signed-in surfaces plus section-9.2 states capturable and judgeable on the first extended-collector receipt.

code: cargo test in src-tauri reports 20 passed and 0 failed including golden_path_section3_self_drive.
cargo fmt --check exits 0 across all Rust sources on the delivered tree.
runtime: A live self-drive of the embedded-assets build clicks #golden-path-trigger once and records data-goldenpath-state=pass with data-goldenpath-passed=16 within the bounded timeout.
Before the trigger click, the anonymous invalid-email smoke still produces its validation delta with the probe idle at 0 of 16.
visual: Diagnostic self-check captures of Today, Inbox, Projects, Calendar, Focus, and Settings at 1280x800 and one narrow width accompany the developer report, pending host recapture as binding evidence.
No capture shows prohibited section-9 patterns: dark-blue full-page background, dashboard tiles, pill-shaped labels, or overlapping text at narrow width.

done_when: cargo test in src-tauri reports 20 passed and 0 failed including golden_path_section3_self_drive, and cargo fmt --check exits 0.
A recorded live self-drive of the embedded-assets build shows exactly one #golden-path-trigger click and data-goldenpath-state=pass with data-goldenpath-passed=16 within the bounded timeout.
Each of the six signed-in views renders in the live signed-in session with an intentional empty or populated state and survives a narrow-width check without overlapping or clipped text.

The probe, trigger, anonymous smoke behavior, and deeplink counters are unchanged from the contract in instruction 1, confirmed by the green unit suite and an attribute-level diff in the developer report.

evidence_resolution.rationale: find.deeplink-scheme-not-registered, find.first-run-gui-drive-missing, and find.golden-path-surfaces-missing all carry blocked_by fnd.replay-collector-cannot-conclude-golden-path: the registered replay has no trigger step and golden_path_observation() hardcodes state=unavailable, so no candidate can ever conclude the lane. The receipt-shaped acceptance is correct and is not waived; the host lands the trigger, poll, and promote extension this loop per its blocking focus, and this task makes the candidate drivable-live so that measurement infrastructure can finally conclude on the new hash. Rewriting acceptance would only lower the bar without producing the PRD section-3 evidence the release needs.

tasks.instructions: Deliver the candidate the host-extended replay will consume. (1) Preserve the proven terminal contract exactly: trigger-only 24x24 #golden-path-trigger, 16-step drive ending signed in on Today, fail reporting with step and reason code, terminal-readable data-goldenpath-* and data-deeplink-* attributes, backend-held credentials, unchanged anonymous invalid-email smoke, and intact product-UI versus diagnostic separation. (2) Build and launch the app from the embedded-assets profile, click the real trigger through the provisioned local WebDriver, and confirm data-goldenpath-state reaches pass with data-goldenpath-passed=16 within a bounded timeout in the live webview; fix any unit-versus-live divergence (IPC wiring, build gating, timing) without auto-starting the drive or referencing navigator.webdriver. (3) In the same signed-in live session, walk Today, Inbox, Projects, Calendar, Focus, and Settings; against PRD sections 8 and 9 verify and fix intentional loading, empty, error, retry, and narrow-width states so the host's first captures are judgeable. (4) Keep the 20/20 rust suite green and all sources rustfmt-clean; add no startup test mutations and keep credentials, tokens, and email content out of DOM, logs, and screenshots.

risk_note.summary: The live webview can expose divergences the in-process units never see — IPC timing, probe gating in the shipped build, or slow mail-sink steps — and surface fixes could regress the frozen contract.
risk_note.validation: Most likely to end insufficient_evidence if only the dev build or rust units are checked; mitigation is requiring the embedded-assets live drive with the terminal probe state recorded in the developer report.
risk_note.why_now: The host lands the collector trigger-and-poll extension this loop, so the first extended receipt on the new hash is the only chance to convert eight loops of stalled evidence.
